title: Late Charges — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
A late charge on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract can be assessed only while the contract status is active or assigned for repossession.

**Grace period.** A late charge may be assessed only after the late-charge grace period following the installment due date has fully elapsed. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the installment due date, weekends and holidays included, so the first permissible assessment date is the calendar day after the due date plus the grace days. The clock starts from the installment due date recorded on the contract.

**One per installment.** No more than one late charge may be assessed for the same installment due date.

**Amount.** The late charge is the late-charge percent of the unpaid installment portion — the monthly payment less the payment amounts applied to that installment, as of the assessment date — rounded to the cent and capped at the lower of the company maximum late charge and the contract's recorded state maximum late charge.

**No charge.** No late charge is assessed when the unpaid portion is less than the minimum unpaid amount, on an installment deferred by an extension, or on an installment that was paid in full within the grace period. A payment that posts after the cutoff on the last grace day posts the next business day and is late.

### Grace boundary (10-day grace period)

| Assessment date | Permitted? |
|---|---|
| The 10th calendar day after the due date (last grace day) | No — the grace period has not fully elapsed |
| The 11th calendar day after the due date | Yes — the first permissible assessment date |

### Amount checks (hypothetical figures)

- Unpaid portion $300.00, recorded state maximum $20.00: 5.0 percent is $15.00, below both caps, so the late charge is $15.00.
- Unpaid portion $800.00, recorded state maximum $25.00: 5.0 percent is $40.00; the lower cap is $25.00, so the late charge is $25.00.
- Unpaid portion $9.50: below the $10.00 minimum, so no late charge.
